evidence: Matches 'Build system' label, modifies .github/workflows/ci.yml, and updates minimum supported macOS toolchain requirements.
rationale: Bumping the minimum Xcode Command Line Tools version establishes an LLVM-19 baseline following macOS Sonoma's EOL. As stated by the author, upgrading CLT to 26.3 'will allow to use C++20 CTAD and also allow switching the project to C++23', providing worthwhile leverage for future toolchain and language modernizations.
